title: The Great Privilege of Those That Are Born of God
edition: Printed in the 1771 Works. The Pine printing does not give a preach date for this sermon.
blurb: Rendered in modern English, to be read and heard. Open the 1771 text under each part to check the claims and the scripture.
era_note: John Wesley lived from 1703 to 1791. This sermon is in his 1771 Works. The printing does not give a preach date. It is an English sermon, not an ante-Nicene father.

text_history.method: Rendered in modern English. The 1771 panel is his own Pine printing of the Works. It is public domain.
text_history.identifiers: Sermon 19 in the 1771 Works. First John 3:9.
